_about: Regular expressions the mod matches against Hypixel text. Copy this file to config/sbcompanion/patterns/ to override entries without rebuilding; use /sbc reload.
RoomPuzzles.WEIRDO: ^\[NPC\] ([A-Z][a-z]+): (?:The reward is(?: not in my chest!|n't in any of our chests\.)|My chest (?:doesn't have the reward\. We are all telling the truth\.|has the reward and I'm telling the truth!)|At least one of them is lying, and the reward is not in [A-Z][a-z]+'s chest!|Both of them are telling the truth\. Also, [A-Z][a-z]+ has the reward in their chest!)$
RoomPuzzles.QUESTION: ^ {2,}([A-Za-z0-9,' ]+\?)$
RoomPuzzles.ORUO: ^\[STATUE\] Oruo the Omniscient: (\w+ answered Question #\d correctly!|I bestow upon you all the power of a hundred years!|Yikes)$
